additions.name: GreyNoise Community
additions.description: Free IP lookup that tells you whether an address is internet background noise (mass scanners) or a benign known service, cutting alert triage time.
additions.notes: Unauthenticated: ~10 lookups/day. Free account with a business email (non-Gmail/Hotmail/etc.): 50 combined lookups/week across API + Visualizer. Full historical/tag data is paid.

additions.name: JARM (Salesforce)
additions.description: Open-source active TLS server fingerprinting scanner that hashes ten crafted Client Hello responses to cluster servers by TLS stack, useful for spotting C2 frameworks like Cobalt Strike.
additions.notes: Free Python CLI/library; JARM fingerprints are now searchable inside Censys, Shodan, FOFA and Hunt.io rather than only run locally.

additions.name: Hunt.io
additions.description: Threat-hunting search engine indexing internet-wide JARM/JA4T fingerprints, favicon hashes and HTTP response bodies to pivot from one malicious host to an operator's full infrastructure.
additions.notes: Free tier gives limited daily searches of its HuntSQL/Advanced Search dataset; full historical querying and API access require a paid plan.

additions.name: ipctl.io
additions.description: ASN, BGP route and netblock-ownership lookup tool for tracing an IP or prefix back to its announcing network and upstream providers.
additions.notes: Basic ASN/prefix/route lookups are free in the browser; bulk and API access require a paid key.

additions.name: RPKI Validator / RIPE RPKI Dashboard
additions.description: Checks whether an IP prefix has a valid Route Origination Authorization (ROA), flagging BGP hijacks and unauthorized route announcements for a given ASN or netblock.
additions.notes: Free, no account needed; run by RIPE NCC, one of the five Regional Internet Registries.

additions.name: DomScan
additions.description: Unified domain-intelligence API and web console that aggregates WHOIS/RDAP, DNS records, SSL certificate data and subdomains for a target domain in a single query.
additions.notes: Free tier includes a limited number of monthly lookups; higher volume and full API access require a paid plan.

additions.name: ScanSearch
additions.description: On-demand internet scanning search engine that runs fresh Nmap-grade port/service scans against a target IP or domain rather than relying only on a stale historical database.
additions.notes: A handful of free scans per day without an account; subscription (~$30/mo tier) unlocks unlimited/scheduled scans.

additions.name: OpenSanctions
additions.description: Consolidated, deduplicated database of sanctions lists, PEP registries and criminal watchlists from 100+ official sources, searchable by name or queryable via a fuzzy-matching API.
additions.notes: Free API keys are issued to journalists/researchers/non-profits for the /match and /search endpoints; commercial screening use requires a paid API contract.

additions.name: OCCRP Aleph Pro
additions.description: Investigative-data search platform that cross-references leaked archives, corporate registries and government records to trace beneficial ownership, financial flows and persons of interest.
additions.notes: Public aleph.occrp.org instance stays free for open records; access to protected leaked datasets requires a vetted application (~72hr review). Migrated to the new 'Aleph Pro' SaaS stack in Dec 2025; nonprofit journalism gets Aleph Pro free forever, commercial tiers launching through 2026.

additions.name: ipinfo.io
additions.description: IP geolocation and ASN/company lookup API returning city-level location, hosting provider, ASN, VPN/proxy and abuse-contact data for a given IP address.
additions.notes: 50,000 free API lookups/month without a credit card; VPN/proxy detection and higher volumes require a paid plan.

changes.name: Shodan
changes.detail: Free-account web search now returns only a small handful of results per query (commonly cited as 2-10) with filters disabled; full search requires a paid membership, though the separate free InternetDB API (no account) still gives basic port/vuln data per IP.

changes.name: Censys
changes.detail: Censys retired its old free-forever 'Legacy Search' UI and moved everyone to the credit-metered Censys Platform; free accounts now get a small monthly credit allotment and lookup-only (non-scriptable) search rather than unrestricted querying.

changes.name: SecurityTrails
changes.detail: SecurityTrails (now under Recorded Future) no longer publishes a usable free public tier; historical DNS, WHOIS history and subdomain data require a paid API/SOC plan, with pricing available only on request.

changes.name: RiskIQ PassiveTotal
changes.detail: The standalone RiskIQ/PassiveTotal community platform is effectively dead (broken logins, expired/mismatched TLS certs); its passive-DNS successor Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence is itself being retired and folded into Defender XDR as an enterprise-only add-on around August 2026, removing the free/community access path entirely.

changes.name: ZoomEye
changes.detail: ZoomEye migrated its main site and API from zoomeye.org/api.zoomeye.org (JWT auth) to zoomeye.ai and api.zoomeye.ai/v2 with a new API-KEY header scheme; the free tier remains points-based but old integration URLs and legacy auth are deprecated.

changes.name: DNSDumpster
changes.detail: DNSDumpster now runs on a documented HackerTarget-operated free tier of 50 lookups/day (down from effectively unlimited casual use), with a paid 'Plus' tier at 200/day plus bulk/API access for higher volume.

changes.name: Open Ownership Register
changes.detail: The public Open Ownership Register prototype was closed on 29 November 2024; Open Ownership shifted to publishing raw BODS beneficial-ownership datasets for download/reuse rather than hosting a live public search register.

changes.name: BuiltWith
changes.detail: Single-domain technology lookups on the public site remain free indefinitely, but BuiltWith's API surface now splits into a free-forever Free API/Trends API and a separate metered Domain/Lists/Relationships API starting near $295/month for programmatic or bulk access.

changes.name: WhoisXML API
changes.detail: WHOIS/RDAP, subdomain and DNS-history lookups are limited to a small free monthly credit allotment (commonly around 500-1000 credits) tied to a required registered account; sustained or bulk OSINT use requires a paid subscription.
